system.description:
The blows of swords and siege engines are almost as nothing to you. When you suffer lethal or bashing damage, make one Simple Test for each level of damage taken. If you win, you may ignore that level of damage. You may spend a Stamina-related Physical Trait before the test to win on a tie.

Using Imperviousness is reflexive and does not count as an action. You may use Imperviousness on damage that was reduced to lethal from aggravated by Resilience.
